items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: So I got him up on the drums at one concert in Limoges.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was living in France. So I got him up on the drums at one concert in Limoges. And he was walking with a cane. And he sat down at the drums and he picked his sticks up, and Eddie Jones was the bass player. He looked down and said, “It’s a ballad — the next tune is a ballad.” And Papa Jo looked over him in his cantankerous way as he always was and said, “You don’t tell me I tell you.” And so he proceeded to play. They played the ballad and then they played a brighter tune like “Jumpin’ at the Woodside” or…
